title: schc: compression vectors failing for CoAP/OSCORE rules
description:
The test_schc_compression_vectors test is failing for 4 vectors:
- coap_linklocal (rule 0): expected 30 bytes, got 33
- coap_global (rule 1): expected 44 bytes, got 49
- oscore_linklocal (rule 5): expected 33 bytes, got 36
- oscore_global (rule 6): expected 47 bytes, got 52

The Rust implementation is producing larger compressed output than expected. Either the compression rules need updating or the test vectors are stale.
close_reason: Already fixed: commit 84a882f519 refactored SCHC to use external crate - all compression vectors now pass (coap_linklocal=30B, coap_global=44B, oscore_linklocal=33B, oscore_global=47B)
